correct_query: SELECT QUERY_NAME, ROUND(AVG(RATING/POSITION), 2) AS QUALITY, ROUND(100*SUM(CASE WHEN RATING<3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(1), 2) AS POOR_QUERY_PERCENTAGE FROM QUERIES GROUP BY QUERY_NAME
